bundle.shortDescription: Capture, identify and export vinyl recordings.
bundle.longDescription: VCW is a workstation for putting records onto a computer: a bit-perfect capture that commits continuously so a crash costs a quarter of a second, track detection you can correct, metadata from MusicBrainz and Discogs, and tagged WAV or FLAC out the other end. One project is one file. Audacity projects can be imported.
